description: Inserts one item (row) into a collection and returns it, including the generated primary key. Use bulk_operations for many rows in one call, import_data for a CSV or JSON file, update_item to change a row that exists. Directus validates the payload, so a missing required field or a failed validation rule comes back as a tool error and nothing is written. Fields the token may not write are rejected rather than silently dropped. The payload may include relational fields, which Directus resolves against the related collection.
name: create_item
